run_sweep.description: Start a sweep job. Argument spec: object, required, a job specification whose job field equals "sweep". Returns jobId (string), accepted (boolean), plan (object). Operator approval required.

run_fit.description: Start a fit job. Argument spec: object, required, a job specification whose job field equals "fit". Returns jobId (string), accepted (boolean), plan (object). Operator approval required.

run_evaluate.description: Start a evaluate job. Argument spec: object, required, a job specification whose job field equals "evaluate". Returns jobId (string), accepted (boolean), plan (object). Operator approval required.

job_status.description: Job status. Argument jobId: string, required. Returns state, one of: queued, running, completed, failed, refused.

get_artifact.description: Get a job file. Arguments, required: jobId (string), path (string). Returns path, inline (object or null), sha256 (string or null), location (string or null).
